links.outcome: Change in decisional conflict (DCS) using ChatGPT-4 versus Google for treatment questions
links.effect: DCS fell in both arms (ChatGPT -4.3, 95% CI -7.1 to -1.5, p=0.004; Google -2.7, 95% CI -4.3 to -1.1, p=0.002) with no significant difference between groups; MCQ knowledge and treatment preferences unchanged.
links.quote: Both groups showed significant reductions in DCS scores with a mean difference of -4.3 in the ChatGPT arm (95% CI: -7.1 to -1.5, p = 0.004) and -2.7 in the Google arm (95% CI: -4.3 to -1.1, p = 0.002), with no significant difference between groups.

screen.reason: Prospective randomized trial evaluating patient use of ChatGPT-4 versus Google search to facilitate shared decision-making in a rhinology clinic.
